evidenceClass: original2016 skill/BuffFactor/effect declarations + qualified fixed-V5/2026 factory reference + current Web lifetime regression

originalDurationProvenance.descriptionField: m_wstrMainDesc: Dynamo Factory Mode Duration : 30 secs
originalDurationProvenance.durationLevels: All original levels 1 through 30 declare 30 seconds.

displayProvenance.closure: Exact MAIN_EFFECT_NAME plus PASSIVE_PARTICLE/TIME_PARTICLE names and recursive TraceParticleList/FinalParticleList descendants. These two displays have no further Trace/Final descendants.
displayProvenance.ownership: The 999-second main is explicitly destroyed when the factory mode ends. Its own template lifetime is not the mode duration. Particle emission stops; existing authored finite particles expire.

reference.stateEnd: ANSI_AAT_CREATE_DYNAMO_FACTORY_StateEnd calls CommonStateEnd; the skill action ending is separate from the persistent factory mode.
reference.qualification: Fixed-V5 source contains 2026 reconstructed factory callbacks. It corroborates handle ownership but is not an original target-client execution or a 1:1 target consumer claim.

webObservation.selectionState: actor.sourceAdd.generator: skillId, phase, generation, remaining; there is no elapsed field.
webObservation.selectionEvent: addGeneratorSelected carries the selected skill and original remaining duration. Prefer its source step/time or the first observed selected generator when measuring mode age; attack start is a later clock.
webObservation.liveDisplayIdentity: Exact ownerId and displays[selectedSkillId].effectName/mainEffectName, associated with a still-valid selected generator. Raw particle counts are not independent attack-controller handles.
webObservation.expiredState: actor.sourceAdd.generator is null; tickAddFactory emits add-factory-generation-ended for its previous exact display handle.
webObservation.graceQualification: Five seconds is a bounded current-Web test allowance, not an original particle lifetime or an additional original mode duration.

regression.method: Actual Native selection and firing inputs; attack phase retires at the earlier source-specific observation while the selected factory display remains. The same simulation then reaches natural mode expiry and finite presentation tail cleanup without reset.
regression.presentationQualification: Production effects-view with original mesh/pose assets under NullEngine and ready white-pixel texture I/O; separate from browser/GPU and original-client measurement.
